story.summaryZh: 前F1世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格认为，基米·安东内利在本赛季总冠军争夺收官阶段面临的最大障碍是他自己。
story.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli versus his mind will decide 2026 Formula 1 title race, says Nico Rosberg ahead of Azerbaijan Grand Prix
story.summaryEn: Former F1 world champion Nico Rosberg believes that Kimi Antonelli's biggest obstacle in the closing stages of this season's title fight is himself.
detailZh: 尼科·罗斯伯格表示，基米·安东内利与自己的心理较量将决定2026年一级方程式总冠军之争，这番话是在阿塞拜疆大奖赛之前说的
在天空体育F1节目《The F1 Show》的最新一期中，尼科·罗斯伯格讨论了基米·安东内利要想成为世界冠军需要克服什么；从本周四开始，在天空体育F1频道直播阿塞拜疆大奖赛的每一节练习赛和排位赛，正赛将于周六中午12点播出
尼科·罗斯伯格认为，唯一能阻止基米·安东内利夺得世界冠军的就是他自己
前一级方程式世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格认为，在本赛季冠军争夺战的收官阶段，基米·安东内利最大的障碍将是他自己。
安东内利有望在20岁时成为一级方程式历史上最年轻的世界冠军，目前他领先梅赛德斯队友拉塞尔81分，领先法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿101分，领先迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯106分。
今年只剩下九轮比赛，首先是本周的阿塞拜疆大奖赛，比赛将于周六中午12点举行，由天空体育F1频道和天空体育主频道进行直播。

在天空体育《F1秀》最新一期节目中，罗斯伯格谈到了自己2016年夺冠的经历，当时他经历了一场激烈的心理斗争，而安东内利可能也需要克服同样的挑战。
罗斯伯格说：“我知道当我成为最大热门时，我的大脑是怎么开始和我玩心理游戏的。”
你可以随时通过隐私选项更改你的设置。
“当你真正成为最大热门时，就像他现在的处境一样，那种感觉就是：‘天哪，这冠军实际上唾手可得。我最好别搞砸，最好别犯愚蠢的、不必要的错误，因为世界冠军就在眼前’。”
“一旦这类想法冒出来，你就会开始害怕，真的开始恐惧自己会完全没必要地把事情搞砸，因为毕竟驾驶一级方程式赛车并保持在车阵前列，当然是世界上最难做到的事情之一。”
"要不出错并一直保持状态，一次又一次地做出不错的排位成绩、又不撞上护墙，实在是太难了。犯错太容易了，因为这本身就难到了极点。然后你的脑子开始混乱，就会夺走你专注于开好车所需的精力。"
尼科称梅赛德斯车手安东内利为一代天才
安东内利没有表现出任何紧张的迹象，他赢得了最近两场比赛，包括在蒙扎的主场赛事中从第十九位发车一路惊人地追到第一名，随后一周又在马德里的全新赛道上夺冠。
2016年，罗斯伯格与汉密尔顿的冠军争夺战要激烈得多，但当时他的处境是并不需要赢下最后四场比赛，他可以接受拿下两个第二和一个第三。
他继续说道："当我争夺世界冠军时，最后四场比赛就是我脑子里真正开始疯狂的时候，在那最后四场比赛里，我完全没有可能拿到杆位或者再赢一场比赛，因为我用于真正把车开好的脑力大约少了百分之三十。"
安东内利表示，F1车手总冠军之争还没有结束
“通常情况下，我可以说是百分之百专注于把车开好，而这次只有百分之七十是在把车开好，另外百分之三十完全是害怕犯下愚蠢的错误，从而失去我赢得一级方程式世界冠军的机会，这个机会实在是太重大了。”
“这也是基米·安东内利从八岁起就一直努力追逐的一个巨大梦想。所以这是他12年来对生活全身心的投入，这占据了他人生的一大半，只为了实现有朝一日成为F1世界冠军的梦想。这个梦想太大了。”
“这是我们需要重点关注的大问题。现在真的是他和自己的心理在较量，我们看看情况会怎样，但他目前的表现非常出色。”
罗斯伯格：如果迈凯伦逐渐拉开差距，将是最糟糕的情况
安东内利在赛季的大部分时间里基本上都压制住了队友拉塞尔，所以除非这种情况突然改变，他最大的竞争威胁可能来自法拉利或迈凯伦在研发进度上超过梅赛德斯。
诺里斯本有可能在过去四场比赛中赢下三场，要不是上一站马德里比赛中一次不合时宜的虚拟安全车，所以他尽管目前在车手积分榜上排名第四，看起来仍是安东内利最大的威胁。
迈凯伦为本周末在巴库的比赛带来了新部件，而梅赛德斯则将在下周在马来西亚的比赛中带来一套重要升级包。
兰多·诺里斯对摩纳哥大奖赛将于2027年举办冲刺赛的消息作出反应。
“最坏的情况是迈凯伦突然开始逐渐拉开差距，也许法拉利也会有所进步之类，而基米开始更多地掉回车阵中，”罗斯伯格说。
“这又和我夺冠那年的情况类似，因为当时我的驾驶状态不佳，在最后四场比赛中我开始掉回车阵。”
看看安东内利如何从第19位一路赶超到第一位，在意大利大奖赛上夺得一场轰动性的胜利。
“甚至在墨西哥排位赛中直到最后一刻，我在第三节排位赛里其实一直只排在第六。在那几场比赛里，我一度只排在第三而不是第二，而且马克斯·维斯塔潘几乎每场比赛都在撞击我。”
“如果你稍微往后掉进车群之中，风险就会再次增加，你会开始变得越来越慌乱。”

detailEn: Kimi Antonelli versus his mind will decide 2026 Formula 1 title race, says Nico Rosberg ahead of Azerbaijan Grand Prix

On the latest episode of Sky Sports F1's The F1 Show, Nico Rosberg discusses what Kimi Antonelli will need to overcome to become world champion; watch every session of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from this Thursday live on Sky Sports F1, with the race on Saturday at 12pm
Nico Rosberg believes the only thing that can stop Kimi Antonelli winning the world title is himself
Former Formula 1 world champion Nico Rosberg believes Kimi Antonelli's biggest obstacle will be himself in this season's title race run-in.

Antonelli is on course to become F1's youngest world champion at 20 years old as he leads Mercedes team-mate George Russell by 81 points, Ferrari's Lewis Hamiton by 101 points and McLaren's Lando Norris by 106 points.
Just nine rounds remain this year, starting with this week's Azerbaijan Grand Prix which will see the race take place on Saturday at 12pm, live on Sky Sports F1 and Sky Sports Main Event.

Speaking on the latest episode of Sky Sports' The F1 Show, Rosberg brought up his own title-winning experience in 2016 where he faced a big mental battle which Antonelli may also need to overcome.
"I know how my head started to play games with me when I was the big favourite," said Rosberg.
You can change your settings at any time via the Privacy Options.

"When you're really the big favourite, like he is now, it's like, 'oh my God, this is this is actually mine for the taking. I better not mess this up, I better not make these make stupid mistakes and unnecessary mistakes now because the World Championship is there for the taking'.

"As soon as those kind of thoughts come in, you start to get scared and you really start to get fear that you're going to mess something up completely unnecessarily because it remains that driving an F1 car and being at the front of the pack, of course, is one of the hardest things in the world to do.

"It is so damn difficult to not make mistakes and to be there, qualify time and time again and do good laps and not put it on the wall. It is easy to make mistakes because it's just so damn hard. Then your head starts to go, and it just takes capacity away from your concentration to drive well."
Nico described Mercedes driver Antonelli as a generational talent
Antonelli has shown no signs of any nerves as he has won the last two races, including an incredible drive from 19th to first at his home event at Monza, then at a new track in Madrid a week later.
In 2016, Rosberg was in a much tighter title fight against Hamilton but was in a position where he did not need to win the last four races and could afford to finish second, with one third.

He continued: "When I was going for my World Championship, the last four races, that's when it really went crazy in my head, and there was no chance in the world for me to do a pole position or to win another race in those last four races because I had like 30 per cent less capacity in my mind to actually drive well.
Antonelli says the F1 Drivers' Championship is not over yet

"Usually, it's like 100 per cent to drive well, and now it was 70 per cent to drive well, and 30 per cent was just absolutely terrified to make some stupid mistake and lose my opportunity to win the Formula 1 World Championship, which is just so extremely big.

"It was a massive dream that also Kimi has been working towards since he's eight years old. So it's 12 years of dedicating his life, which is more than half of his life, towards the dream of maybe being F1 world champion. It's so big.
"That's the big one that we need to keep an eye out. It's really him against his mind now, so we see how that goes, but he's doing incredibly well."
Rosberg: Worst-case scenario if McLaren edge away

Antonelli has largely had the upper hand on team-mate Russell for much of the season, so unless that suddenly changes, his biggest competition could come from Ferrari or McLaren outdeveloping Mercedes.

Norris could have won three of the last four races, had it not been for an untimely virtual safety car last time out in Madrid, so he appears to be Antonelli's biggest threat despite being fourth in the Drivers' Championship.
McLaren have new parts for this weekend's race in Baku, before Mercedes bring a major upgrade package for next week's race in Malaysia.
Lando Norris reacts to the news that the Monaco Grand Prix will be a Sprint race in 2027

"The worst-case scenario is if suddenly McLaren starts to edge away, and maybe there's also a Ferrari improvement or something, and Kimi starts to drop back into the pack a little bit more," said Rosberg.
"That again is similar to where I was in my championship year, because I was not driving as well, I started to drop back into the pack in those last four races.
Watch how Antonelli converted 19th to first to take a sensational victory at the Italian Grand Prix

"Even in Mexico in qualifying until the last moment, I was actually only sixth in Q3 until the last moment. In each of those races, I was P3 at some point and not P2, and Max Verstappen was banging into me like every single race.
"If you were to drop back into the pack ever so slightly, again, the risk just comes up more and you start to get more and more panicked about things."

detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿：法拉利车队的七届F1世界冠军在访问拉法口岸后，呼吁以色列“放行援助卡车”进入加沙。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿周二访问了拉法口岸，实地了解向加沙运送援助物资的工作；这位法拉利车手周三在Instagram发帖，呼吁以色列“履行停火协议下的义务”。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在访问拉法口岸后，呼吁以色列“放行援助卡车”进入加沙。
汉密尔顿周二在埃及，实地了解向加沙运送人道主义与救援物资的工作。这位法拉利车手还参观了拉法口岸，并走访了埃及红新月会的援助仓库。
美国支持的以色列与哈马斯之间的停火协议仍然有效，但并未结束以色列对加沙的打击，同时联合国世界粮食计划署表示，加沙三分之二的人口难以获得足够的食物。
汉密尔顿此前曾呼吁该地区实现和平，他表示援助物资因“疯狂的理由”被拒绝进入加沙。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿（@lewishamilton）分享的一条帖子。
您可以随时通过隐私选项更改您的设置。
这位七届世界冠军在Instagram上发文称：“过去三年以色列在加沙的种族灭绝行径令人震惊。”
“人们被剥夺自由、安全和尊严，这是不公正的。任何人都不应被当作生命不那么重要来对待。”
“我看到绵延数英里的围墙，是为了把他们困在里面而建的。站在外面，感觉就像一座露天监狱，我满脑子想的都是进去帮忙。”
“在拉法口岸，我看到食品卡车排着队准备出发，但它们经常不被允许进入，或者面临严重延误。我交谈过的排在第一位的那位司机已经等了超过12个小时。”
在附近的物流中心，我看到了救援人员的辛勤工作，但我也看到了因荒唐理由被拒绝的物资。睡袋、急救包、医疗设备、轮椅，甚至给孩子们的足球。
以色列需要履行停火协议下的义务，让援助卡车进入。没有任何借口。
我知道很多人都感受到同样的无助。同样觉得需要做点什么，而不是袖手旁观。我不想让我们对他们的苦难习以为常。我不想让我们移开视线。
周三，以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡否认以色列在拖延物资进入加沙，并将加沙不断恶化的状况归咎于哈马斯，指责他们拒绝解除武装并截留援助物资用于军事用途。
2021年，汉密尔顿创立了Mission 44慈善机构，旨在支持年轻人并改善他们获得教育和就业机会的途径。
他还支持了人道主义和救援倡议，以及为受冲突影响的人们提供帮助的努力。
汉密尔顿是在上周末参加圣保罗大奖赛并获得第九名后进行了此次访问。他接下来将代表法拉利参加拉斯维加斯大奖赛，第一次练习赛于11月20日星期五举行。
汉密尔顿分享了与加沙儿童会面的细节
在首次发帖一天后，汉密尔顿于周四再次通过社交媒体分享了他与从加沙撤离的儿童互动的细节。
除了分享一组自己与孩子们的合影外，汉密尔顿写道：“在埃及见到一些由@inaraorg支持的从加沙撤离的巴勒斯坦儿童，我的心都碎了。
“这些美丽、聪明的孩子经历了创伤、悲痛和可怕的伤害，这些是任何孩子都不应该承受的事情。有些孩子在袭击中中弹或严重烧伤，仍在面对复杂的康复之路。但真正打动我的是他们如此坚韧，而且似乎在彼此身上找到了许多快乐。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿（@lewishamilton）分享的帖子
您可以随时通过隐私选项更改您的设置。
“当我问起他们的梦想时，他们谈到想成为老师和医生，这样就能像曾经帮助过他们的人那样去帮助别人。在经历了这一切之后，他们仍然想象着一个关爱他人的未来。这让我一直难以忘怀。
“我在学校、医院和一家心理健康诊所遇到了孩子们，帮助他们走出创伤。我还走进了一些家庭，倾听他们关于康复以及与亲人——他们的孩子、父母、兄弟姐妹——分离的故事。那种分离和不确定带来的痛苦令人难以理解。
“他们的故事让我想到了仍留在加沙的孩子们，他们生活在恶劣的条件下。据报道，自2023年10月以来，已有超过21500名儿童丧生，45000人受伤。他们每一个人都曾有过一个家和一个未来。我们不能忘记他们。
“这些孩子和你们的孩子没有不同。他们的生命同样珍贵。他们本应能在教室里与朋友相伴感到安全，与家人在一起，并憧憬未来。我非常感激我遇到的年轻人正在获得他们所需的帮助，但他们不得不离开家园去寻找安全，这令人心碎。”
加沙卫生当局表示，自2023年10月以色列开始对加沙发动攻势以来，已有超过74000人丧生。
以色列是在哈马斯武装人员对以色列南部发动袭击后发起这次攻势的，以方称该袭击造成约1200人死亡。

detailEn: Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari's seven-time F1 world champion urges Israel to 'let the aid trucks in' to Gaza after visit to Rafah border

Lewis Hamilton visited the Rafah border on Tuesday to witness efforts to transport aid into Gaza; Ferrari driver published Instagram post on Wednesday calling on Israel to "fulfil its obligations under the ceasefire"
Lewis Hamilton urged Israel to "let the aid trucks in" to Gaza after visiting the Rafah border.

Hamilton was in Egypt on Tuesday to witness efforts to deliver humanitarian and relief aid bound for Gaza. The Ferrari driver also toured the Rafah border crossing and visited the Egyptian Red Crescent's aid warehouses.

The US-backed ceasefire between Israel and Hamas remains in place but has not ended Israeli strikes on Gaza, while the UN World Food Programme says two-thirds of Gaza's population are struggling to get enough to eat.
Hamilton - who has previously called for peace in the region - said aid was being denied entry into Gaza for "crazy reasons".

The seven-time world champion posted on Instagram: "The past three years of Israel's genocide in Gaza is appalling.
"It's an injustice for people to be denied their freedom, their safety and their dignity. No human being should be treated as though their life matters less.
"I saw walls stretching for miles, built to keep them in. Standing there, outside what felt like an open-air prison, all I could think about was getting in to help.
"At Rafah border, I saw food trucks lined up ready to go, but they're regularly not allowed in or face major delays. The first driver in line that I spoke to had already been waiting over 12 hours.

"At the nearby logistics centre, I saw the hard work of the aid workers, but I also saw what gets rejected for crazy reasons. Sleeping bags, first-aid kits, medical equipment, wheelchairs, even footballs for kids.
"Israel needs to fulfil its obligations under the ceasefire and let the aid trucks in. No excuse.
"I know so many people feel that same helplessness. That same need to do something rather than just watch. I don't want us to get used to their suffering. I don't want us to look away."

On Wednesday, Benjamin Netanyahu, the Israeli Prime Minister, denied Israel was delaying the entry of supplies into Gaza, and blamed Hamas for the worsening conditions in Gaza, accusing them of a refusal to disarm and seizing aid for military use.
In 2021, Hamilton founded Mission 44, a charity aimed at supporting young people and improving ⁠access to education and employment ​opportunities.
He has also backed ​humanitarian and relief initiatives, and ​efforts to support people affected by ⁠conflict.
Hamilton made his visit after competing in the Sao Paulo GP last weekend, where he finished ninth. He will next compete for Ferrari in the Las Vegas GP, with Practice 1 on Friday November 20.
Hamilton shares details of meeting children from Gaza
A day after his initial post, Hamilton took to social media again on Thursday to share details of his interactions with children he met who have been evacuated from Gaza.

Along with sharing a selection of photos of himself with the children, Hamilton wrote: "Meeting some of the Palestinian children evacuated from Gaza and supported by @inaraorg in Egypt broke my heart.

"Beautiful, bright children who have faced trauma, grief and horrendous injuries, things no child should ever have to endure. Some have been shot or badly burned in attacks and are still facing a complicated road towards recovery. But what really struck me was how resilient they were and how much joy they seem to find in each other.

"When I asked about their dreams, they spoke about becoming teachers and doctors so they could help others, the way they were helped. After everything they've been through, they still imagine a future caring for other people. That has stayed with me.

"I met children at school, in hospital and at a mental health clinic helping them work through their trauma. I also went into families' homes and listened to their stories of recovery and being separated from loved ones - their children, their parents, their siblings. The pain of that separation and uncertainty is hard to comprehend.

"Their stories made me think about the children still in Gaza, who are living in terrible conditions. According to reports, more than 21,500 children have been killed and 45,000 injured since October 2023. Every one of them had a home and a future. We can't forget them.

"These children are no different from yours. Their lives are just as precious. They should be able to feel safe in a classroom with friends, be with their families and imagine a future. I'm so grateful the young people I met are getting the help they need, but it's heartbreaking that they've had to leave their homes to find safety."
Gaza health authorities say more than 74,000 people have been killed since Israel began its Gaza assault in October 2023.
Israel launched the offensive after Hamas gunmen led an attack on southern Israel, which it said killed around 1,200.
